headline: Barry Callebaut Flavourcode; Roquette gluten-free; Formo casein GRAS; Meala egg swap; UPF rules
summary: Barry Callebaut launched Flavourcode, a fermentation-led cocoa flavour platform, the closest competitor move yet to Belcolade's controlled-fermentation work, while Planet A Foods and Galy push cocoa alternatives into powders and professional kitchens; Belcolade should benchmark all three now.

FDA will allow salt substitutes in standardized breads and rolls from December 14, 2026, and California is adding sugar warnings and 'non-ultraprocessed' seals while states pull UPF from school lunches, so prepare sodium-reduction and clean-label reformulation offers for US customers.
Roquette's Wellence GF 1229 for gluten-free bread and Palsgaard's PowderGel 6800 cake emulsifier are direct competitor launches to benchmark against Puratos gluten-free mixes and cake improvers.

Egg and dairy replacement is scaling: Meala tripled pea-protein output to replace 1,400 t of eggs a year, Formo and Those Vegan Cowboys won FDA GRAS for animal-free casein, and Oobli with Cosun offers a sugar replacer for chocolate; all are partnership candidates for Patisserie and Belcolade.
Fibre and protein remain the main North American bakery theme (Rudi's, Bimbo, Food For Life), supporting Puratos enrichment solutions.
